name: RewardMate – Points & Rewards for WooCommerce
author: OmnifyWP

sections.description:
The Omnify Customer Rewards for WooCommerce is a loyalty plugin that allows website owners to award points to customers based on their purchases and daily logins. This would encourage customers to shop with the store by offering rewards such as discounts on future purchases through the earned points.

Features include:
* Purchase Rewards: Earn points for each purchase to encourage repeat business.
* Daily Check-In Bonus: Customers can check in daily to earn additional bonus points.
* Redeemable Discounts: Customers can use their accumulated points for discounts during checkout.
* Flexible Point Ratios and Values: Customize point values and conversion ratios to align with your store’s strategy.
* Point Display: Show point values on product pages and at checkout to keep customers informed.
* WooCommerce Compatible Points Management: Fully integrated with WooCommerce for seamless currency and points handling.
* Maximum Redemption Limit: Control the percentage of points customers can apply to each order.
* Product-Specific Point Values: Assign custom point values to individual products to incentivize specific items.
* Automatic Refund Adjustments: Adjust customers’ points balances automatically when an order is refunded.
* Admin Point Control: Easily increase or decrease points from the admin panel.
* Point History: Track point history in the admin panel and allow users to view their points on the My Account page.
* Spin Wheel Feature: Offer a fun spin wheel option, allowing customers to win points for future purchases.

How It Works:
1. Customers earn points when they purchase products.
2. Admins can configure point values globally or per product.
3. Points can be used as discounts on future orders.
4. Points are displayed to users on the product page and at checkout.

License

sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin from WordPress.org.
  2. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/omnify-customer-rewards-woocommerce/ directory or install the plugin directly through the WordPress plugin screen.
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  4. Go to WooCommerce -> Settings -> Omnify Customer Rewards to configure the plugin.
sections.faq:
How do I configure points for specific products?

Go to the product edit page in WooCommerce and add the points value in the “Reward Points” section. This value will override the global points setting.

How does the daily check-in feature work?

Customers can visit their “My Account” page each day and click the “Daily Check-In” button to earn bonus points. This feature can be configured in the plugin settings.
